method: Metadata record counts only; no historical records downloaded. Multiply by matching COST measured native-plus-Parquet bytes per provider record. Not a measured download or bound. Standard schema windows with separate available daily extension; excludes operational/derived/filing storage and shared ML.

matched_cost_windows.description: Match the calendar duration of each actual verified COST onboarding request, ending September 12, 2026; clip listing/dataset start. These windows include the extra catch-up days present in the reference archive. They are longer than some current fresh-bootstrap caps.

planning_estimates.scope: Initial symbol-owned stored package: matched recent COST history windows, clipped at listing/provider availability, compressed provider files plus normalized Parquet, daily-price history toward listing using a suitable provider, operational bars/corporate/fundamentals/indicators and metadata allowance. Shared CME/macro are reused. Full SEC document libraries, shared ML rebuilds, long-running captures, backups and temporary download space are excluded.
planning_estimates.allowance_explanation: 0.14 GiB per symbol consists of an illustrative 0.10 GiB operational/indicator budget plus 0.04 GiB metadata/small-partition allowance. Measured comparable stock-research folders range from about 0.064 to 0.18 GiB. Sensitivity applies 0.65-1.5 times measured archive compression plus 0.08-0.25 GiB overhead/operational storage; these are planning scenarios, not statistical confidence bounds.
planning_estimates.history_caveat: Daily listing-date targets do not imply second/minute tick or order-book history since listing. XNAS starts 2018-05-01 and OPRA L0 starts 2013-04-01 in metadata. Older CROX daily prices need a different suitable provider; stock-day records are very small. Calendar month event windows are approximated as 31 days for the standard comparison, with exact historical-reference durations used for the main estimates.
